posts.t:
Hi PS,

So my conclusion: An engulf down does not mean a reversal.

My next question: What kind of PA need to accompany engulfs for a reversal?

RE: Your analysis of USDCHF

This is what i've found after the numerous times that I've got into a trade too early, stopped out and missed the whole setup.

I guess the biggest clue to look for when expecting a reversal is to not expect price to bounce straight off a Daily Supply level (even with engulf's on LTF) but looking to the LTF's for untested FTR's in the HTF Supply where price may be likely to visit.

posts.t: My plan is very short. I mark key levels (weekly, move to daily- mark also). There are always key levels (strong movements). On H4/H1 I 'm looking for Engulfing and FO and then looking for Source of Eng and trade. Also mark QM and Diamond levels only where is key level. Gold rule in RTM is edge of level. Very seldom I trade middle level.
posts.fa: پلنم خیلی کوتاه است. سطوح کلیدی را علامت می‌زنم (هفتگی، به روزانه هم می‌روم - علامت می‌زنم هم). همیشه سطوح کلیدی هست (حرکت‌های قوی). در H4/H1 به دنبال اینگالف و FO هستم و بعد به دنبال منبع اینگالف و معامله. همچنین سطوح QM و الماس را فقط جایی که سطح کلیدی هست علامت می‌زنم. قانون طلایی در RTM لبه سطح است. خیلی به‌ندرت وسط سطح معامله می‌کنم.
